description: Host-loop timings on rostam1 (Intel Xeon Gold 5118), the login node of this cluster. This machine has no GPU; these are not device weights. ALU/libm weights are measured. Memory/stencil weights retain the guestimates: a single-node loop cannot see a ghost exchange, and the measured x/y/z spread is about 14%, not 4x/10x. The benchmark is single-threaded and ran on a shared login node whose shell was affinitized to one of 24 CPUs; repeat medians stayed within about 1% of the minimum. Positive weights are scaled so the smallest is 100; transcendental_default stays 0.

decisions.pow_integer_floor: retained 200: integer-power streaming runs are at or below 1x add (pow2 0.38x through pown16 0.93x) and cannot resolve ALU scaling; log2 formula kept.
decisions.transcendental: measured per-function ratios. sqrt is 2.39x add on the transcendental probe (stored 200; pow sqrt_stream was 0.53x). cbrt is 13.18x on the transcendental probe (stored 1300; pow cbrt_stream was 12.53x).
decisions.symbol_grid: retained 1000: measured grid load is 0.59x add single-node, but the weight guides global-vs-local promotion where distributed costs dominate.
decisions.stencil: retained 1000/4000/10000: measured center/x/y/z are 0.55x/0.58x/0.66x/0.60x add. The y direction is slower, but not by the guestimate 4x/10x, and this loop cannot see a ghost exchange.
decisions.div: streaming div is 1.00x add; register-isolated div is 3.24x add. div reaches the model via Pow[x**-1] with floor 200; left as is.
